response.justification: Strong, versatile senior/staff-level generalist with 15+ years of production engineering across web, backend, mobile and embedded, plus solid TypeScript, cloud (AWS CDK), Kubernetes and testing/engineering-excellence credentials. However, the role requires 8+ years building production AI solutions, and the resume shows roughly one year of AI-adjacent work (MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq). There is no evidence of Python, RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, multi-agent frameworks, or data pipelines for unstructured data. He could plausibly ramp into a forward-deployed engineering role given his breadth, teaching background and MCP exposure, but he does not meet the core GenAI depth bar as written.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems; staff-level scope and breadth
Hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling experience at re:cinq
Strong TypeScript, TDD/CI-CD, cloud and mentoring/teaching track record
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI work vs. 8+ years required in production GenAI
No RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation or multi-agent framework evidence
Python absent from skills; limited data-pipeline and customer-facing consulting signal

key_factors.factor: RAG / vector DB / LLM evaluation gap
Senior engineering breadth, MCP/agent tooling, TypeScript and cloud
